title: HYP-028 Phase 2: biorthogonal Koo-Saleur elements at Yang-Lee measure the TRUE central charge -- c_KS = -4.29 +/- 0.15 vs c = -22/5 = -4.4; c_eff = +2/5 EXCLUDED by sign and magnitude
method: Momentum-resolved biorthogonal sparse ED of the PT-symmetric Yang-Lee chain (lambda=4, h = h_c^inf = 1.5587127 from SIM-070) at L=10..18. Translation-composed non-Hermitian Arnoldi (spectrum real in the PT-unbroken phase); left states via eta=parity (left = P*right). PRODUCT-form KS central charge c_KS = 2<vac_L|H_-2|T_R><T_L|H_+2|vac_R>/(<T_L|T_R><vac_L|vac_R>)*(L/(2 pi v_T))^2 -- no square roots, sign is part of the measurement. THE VACUUM IS |1>, THE SECOND k=0 STATE (physical GS is |phi>, Delta_phi = -2/5). v_T from Delta_T = 2 above |1>; T identified by Delta-gate (1.75, 2.25) above vacuum + element dominance in-window. KS-operator momentum orientation determined empirically (both orientations computed; the dead one is a structural zero ~1e-26). Driver: research/tools/yanglee-pt/qw_yanglee_ks.jl.

unitary_control.extrapolated: 0.49986 (Richardson in 1/L^2 -- unitary corrections are L^-2) vs exact 0.5 (0.03%)
unitary_control.checks: all biorthogonal norms +1.0000 (Hermitian limit), Z2 structural zeros ~1e-24, same orientation convention as YL

results.extrapolation: pairwise 1/L intercepts -3.151, -3.459, -3.683, -3.847; diff ratios 0.730, 0.728 (STABLE); geometric tail sum -> -4.285. Free-exponent fits are degenerate (w->0 runaway) and discarded honestly. Quoted: c_KS = -4.29 +/- 0.15 (estimator systematic).
results.sign: NEGATIVE at every L, both chiralities, machine-real (Im ~ 1e-12 relative)
results.spectrum_checks: Delta_vac(T) -> 2.0 (1.945 -> 1.982 monotone); k=+-2 cluster structure matches the M(2,5) phi level-2 null-vector prediction exactly (ONE phi-descendant at Delta_vac -> 1.6 below T); <1|1> biorthogonal norm NEGATIVE at every L (the conformal vacuum is a negative-norm state -- the indefinite metric visible raw); v_ref from the exact Delta = 2/5 (1-phi) split, 4.24 -> 4.28
results.discrimination: c = -22/5 = -4.400: CONSISTENT (2.6% at ED scale). c_eff = +2/5 = +0.400: EXCLUDED (wrong sign, ~11x magnitude).

key_findings: THE HYP-028 QUESTION IS ANSWERED at ED scale: the Koo-Saleur stress-tensor construction SURVIVES non-unitarity and measures the TRUE central charge c = -22/5, including its indefinite-metric sign -- NOT the effective (Casimir) charge c_eff = 2/5 that governs finite-size energies. [AMENDED 2026-08-17: the sentence that stood here -- 'The biorthogonal element structure sees what the energy spectrum cannot.' -- is WITHDRAWN as false. c = c_eff + 24*h_min recovers the true c from the energy spectrum by arithmetic, and true/complex c has been obtained from spectral routes by Tang et al. (PRL 133, 076504 (2024)) and Zhou & Wang (arXiv:2405.01640). See prior_art.premise_also_false. The measurement itself is unaffected; only the superiority framing is retracted.]

POSITIONING AGAINST PRIOR ART (literature gate run 2026-08-17, outcome FAILED -- the priority claim previously carried here is WITHDRAWN and preserved verbatim in prior_art): biorthogonal Koo-Saleur extraction of a true NEGATIVE central charge on a non-Hermitian lattice was demonstrated by Io, Huang & Hsieh (arXiv:2602.02649) for free fermions at c = -2, and lattice measurement of true vs effective c on non-unitary chains by Couvreur, Jacobsen & Saleur (PRL 119, 040601 (2017)). The present work applies the construction to an INTERACTING chain at the Yang-Lee point M(2,5), and documents an inversion of the unitary state-identification rule.

The T-identification discipline INVERTS at YL: the cross-module product to the phi-descendant is ~10x LARGER than T's (in unitary chains cross-tower elements are ~1e-4 suppressions). Delta-gating above the vacuum is mandatory; raw element dominance silently measures the wrong state.

Implication for the force program: C_TTT = 2 sqrt(2)/sqrt(c) is IMAGINARY at c < 0 -- the graviton self-coupling does not survive as a real amplitude in the non-unitary theory even though alpha = 2 Delta_T = 4 kinematics does. Interpretation (Phase 3, open): the stress-tensor exchange amplitude changes character, not just magnitude, when reflection positivity drops.

The same two-level Richardson estimator that hit 0.01% on SIM-070's R_inf shows MORE stable ratios here (0.730/0.728); the 2.6% residual vs -22/5 is finite-size, not estimator noise. puMPS-scale L would sharpen the third digit.
caveats: ED-scale only (L<=18); corrections are slow (effective w < 1) so the magnitude carries the +/-0.15 estimator band -- the SIGN and the 11x separation from c_eff are unambiguous. Residual h_c^inf error contributes <=0.01 at L=18 (SIM-070 h-sensitivity scaling). L=20 (1M-dim) skipped: sparse H_n build cost, cannot change the discrimination.
verdict: PASSED (discrimination decisive). HYP-028 core question answered: the KS/force construction generalizes to non-unitary CFT carrying the true central charge with its sign. Write-back to HYP-2026-028 (status -> SUPPORTED at ED scale, confidence medium). Phase 3 candidates: interpretation of imaginary C_TTT; puMPS-scale sharpening; the +2.0-Delta phi-descendant cross-module element (anomalously large -- possibly its own observable).

prior_art.premise_also_false: The struck claim's premise -- 'standard approaches obtain only c_eff from Casimir scaling' -- is not merely unnovel, it is wrong. Complex/true c has been obtained from biorthogonal Casimir scaling by Tang et al., PRL 133, 076504 (2024); negative c from OBC energy scaling by Zhou & Wang, arXiv:2405.01640; see also Tu, Tzeng & Chang, SciPost Phys. 12, 194 (2022), Chang et al., PRResearch 2, 033069 (2020), and Shimizu & Kawabata, PRB 112, 085112 (2025) -- the last by the same senior author whose paper SIM-070 reproduces. Because c = c_eff + 24*h_min, c is recoverable from c_eff by arithmetic; the companion gloss in key_findings[0], 'the biorthogonal element structure sees what the energy spectrum cannot', is withdrawn on the same grounds.
what_remains_distinct: (i) A finite-L numerical, error-barred KS ladder in an INTERACTING non-Hermitian chain (prior art is quadratic/free-fermion and fixes c analytically).
(ii) The sharpest available c-vs-c_eff instance: sign flip plus ~11x magnitude separation.
(iii) The provable invariance of the product-form c_KS estimator under eigenvector rescaling and under the full pseudo-Hermitian metric family (true, and previously unclaimed).

(iv) The state-identification INVERSION at Yang-Lee (key_findings[2]): the cross-module phi-descendant element is ~10-11x larger than T's, with opposite sign. The smallest and most defensible atom here, and the one for which no prior statement was found.
Regime difference: the prior free-fermion work sits AT an exceptional point; this run sits inside the PT-unbroken interior.
All of the above are Level 1-2 on the RESEARCH-DIRECTOR.md section 5 scale. None is Level 3.
